en:
We made it out of the
Riven Ring without
incident, and will soon be
going into orbit of our
destination planet.
Hm? ...Wait a moment.
What is it?
Something about this\nplace is not right.
Earthquakes are occurring\nin several different spots\nat a high frequency.

I suspect the cause is an
abnormality at the planet's
core. To know for sure,
however, I will need to run
a proper analysis.
For now, I would strongly\nadvise against stepping\noutside onto...
<font color=yellow>Berbent</font>―planet\nBerbent―that is what we\nshall call this place.
Is there any evidence of\nan excavation beneath\nBerbent's surface?

Let me see. ...Yes, it
appears there is a large
cavernous formation
underground.

E-Eve, I hope you're not
thinking of going down
there! That is a course of
action I must protest!
To do so would put you\nand the Captain in grave\ndanger.

...And all for the sake of
an abnormality occurring
at the planet's center that
you cannot fix.
We cannot turn a blind\neye to the plight which\nplagues this planet!
This is a good opportunity\nto learn more about the\nPurge.
When I'm told I can't do\nsomething, I get the urge\nto do it...
I agree with you, Captain! I\nshall lend you my full\nsupport.
You are absolutely right! It\nis far too early to give up!\nLet us land.

Huh? That was
surprisingly easy. I thought
you'd put up more of a
fight.

My acquisition facilities
are top-notch, meaning I
am a fast learner. Added
to that, I have adjusted
my thought processing to
match yours.

Now, without any further
ado, let us land! We have
a universe to save, after
all!

(Coro sure is learning, but
it's starting to become a
nuisance. Perhaps it is
time for us to hit the
reset button.)

Even if it means starting
danger in the face, we
must do our utmost to
obtain more information,
right?

The fact that a large
cavernous area exists
beneath the surface of
the planet means that the
Purge was here.
Then we must take extra\nprecautions when leaving\nthe ship.

Yes. We also need to be
prepared to escape
quickly―in the case that
things should take a
dangerous turn!
It is just as they say:\n"Love and hate are two\nsides of the same coin."
That makes absolutely no\nsense.
The Captain understands\nwhat I mean!

I shall, however explain it
for your benefit. It means
that, while on the surface
I feel the need to
disagree, on the inside I
fully agree with what the
Captain said.
...Which means I must\nfollow my heart and find a\nway to land us safely!

Nothing about what you
said makes sense. *Sigh* I
suppose it doesn't matter
so long as you get us
where we need to go.

Commencing landing
sequence! This could be
dangerous so please be
sure to hold on tightly!

The ground is shaking
quite vigorously―almost
like rise and fall of the
breast of a woman in love.

...Not that I have seen a
woman in love or ever
even known love. In fact,
now that I think about it, I
do not even understand
the concept.

Aaah! My candy! I got so
caught up in my analogies
that I did not realize that
my secret stash has
revealed itself and spilled
all over the ground!

I-I am terribly sorry,
Captain! We were just hit
by a very large
earthquake. Are you two
all right!?

At the very least, this
planet's problem seems
minor in comparison to
your issues.

The trouble this planet
faces extends deep into
its core―something that is
likely the work of our
Purge friends.

Th-that is absolutely
correct! Before we do
anything else we must
first secure our current
location!
There are so many\nearthquakes happening.
I am not sure there is a\nplace stable enough for us\nto land on.
Good point... It could be\nespecially dangerous if we\nland along a fissure.

I would ask that you take
a counter- jammer and
install it nearby so that
we might use our sensors
freely.

So you have detected the
presence of jamming
waves? I suppose we
should have expected as
much.

Yes. The safety of this
ship now rests in your
hands. I am counting on
you two.

I suppose you two did not
have time to conduct any
surveys of the land in
between bashing all those
dangerous beasts?

While the captain and the
others were busy fighting,
I placed the counter-
jammer as far out as I
could. Can you see
anything?
I am confirming right now.\nThe results should be in\nmomentarily.
Aha! Here we go!

The area we have landed
on is an older stratum of
land, meaning it should be
quite stable.

I have already located the
perimeters of this
continental plate, and
mapped out the
underground water
currents. We should be
fine staying here for now.
I am glad to hear tha―

Another earthquake!? You
were not jesting when you
said this planet is
unstable.

I cannot predict what is
going to occur when. The
expeditions you embark
upon on this planet will
require you to proceed
with the utmost caution.

I found it! I found the
tower―the pulse tower
emitting the jamming
waves.

That was incredibly fast!
After your skilled
navigation through the
Riven Ring, I did not think I
could be any more
impressed with you.
You've finally started to
pull your own weight!

You noticed!? Perhaps my
newfound efficiency is due
to the fine oil I am using. It
was made from the
materials we obtained
previously.

The richness, the
freshness! No words could
describe just how good it
tastes!
I had not realized flavors\nvaried so greatly among\noils.
Wh-what are you talking\nabout!? The flavor is all\nthe same.
But you just said―

*Sigh* I knew words could
not properly describe
what I was trying to
convey.
The richness, the\nfreshness!
...Are you by any chance\nsimply blurting out words\nyou like to say?

You want to enter the
tower? Understood! I shall
provide you with my full
support.
The richness, the\nfreshness!
I have confirmed that the\npulse tower is down and\nthe sensors are back up!

The earthquakes,
however, show no signs of
stopping. They are
occurring at the same
exact rate as before.

Just because we shut
down the pulse tower
doesn't mean that the
issue at the planet's core
will immediately be
resolved. It may take
some time before we see
results.
We have done all that we\ncan. We must now leave\nthe rest up to nature.

I shall begin preparations
for takeoff, so please
come back to the ship at
your earliest convenience.
Welcome back. You two\ndid well. Are you ready to\nleave?
Wait a minute!
Is something the matter?

...There is more than one
large cavernous cavity
below the surface of this
world.
Yes. There are many, and\nall of them were no doubt\ncreated by the Purge.
Can you locate the one\nthat extends the furthest\ninto the planet's core?
I can...but why do you\nneed me to do that?
Didn't you say there is an\nanomaly at the center of\nthe planet?
Yes, I detected it from\norbit.

So if we were to get close
to the center of the
planet and then use
symbology...
...We may be able to save\nthis planet.

Wh-what do you mean? Do
you have some sort of
symbology that can
remove the abnormality?
I cannot say for sure...
E.V.E., that does not\nanswer my question.
What makes you think you\nhave the power to save\nthis planet?
...That's...
Now is not the time for\nbickering.
I, too, am interested in\nhearing the answer to\nthat.
Oooh! An underground\nadventure! This is going to\nbe fun!

Captain, it is very
important that we discuss
this! Eve's actions may
have some very serious
repercussions!

There is always the
possibility that she is an
ally of the Purge who is
attempting to lure us into
a trap!
I-I am very sorry. I should\nnever have said that.
Understood. I shall do\neverything in my power to\nhelp you.

As you say, I should have
no reason to suspect Eve.
We have also only ever
seen her use one kind of
symbology.

By taking a look at what
else is in her repertoire, I
will be able to further
analyze her and maybe
even determine what
species she is.

If going through with this
plan contributes to the
Federation's progress, I
will not deny you my
assistance.
That said, you cannot pull\nthe wool over the\nCaptain's eyes, Eve!

There is still so much that
we do not know about
you. As the individual
charged with ensuring the
safety of this ship and
everyone in it, I had no
choice but to address the
elephant in the room!
Eek!

You are right. Discussing
this under these
circumstances is certainly
far from ideal.
I understand. I shall leave\nit for now and focus solely\non protecting this ship.

As soon as I locate the
deepest cavern, I shall
notify you. The sensors
are back up, so it should
not take long.

...Why are the two of you
just standing there? If we
are going to do this, we
must go at it full force!
Please, get to work!
...Thank you, Coro.
Thank you, <player>.
Now let's do this!

According to my analysis,
this cave will take you
very close to this planet's
core.
Is this what you wanted,\nEve?
Yes. Thank you.

My research indicates
that the soil around this
location is quite stable.
The stratum is very solid,
meaning the possibility of
it collapsing in the event
of an earthquake is
minimal.

That, however, likely
means we will face a
whole host of other
obstacles...

Indeed. This place appears
to have become a safe
haven for all breeds of
beast.
I am detecting a lot of\nvital signals from even\njust the entrance.
You will have to fight your\nway past them.
Captain, we will have to\nproceed with great\ncaution.
Good work. The entrance\nof the cave should now be\nclear.
What about the interior?\nHave you detected any\ndangerous animals?
Allow me to run a scan.\nPlease stand by.
Blargh!!!
Wh-what is it!?

M-my apologies. We were
just hit by a large
earthquake. It seems,
however, that your area is
safe.
Are you all right!?

The ship is fine. The
surrounding area also
does not appear to be too
badly affected.
Aaah!!!
What happened!?

The ice cream I was
planning to eat while I was
waiting for you melted all
over the Captain's seat.
You had best clean that\nup before the Captain\nreturns...
Yes! I shall do that\nimmediately!
But don't forget to scan\nthe cave's interior first!
Emergency! Catastrophe!\nDisaster!
What is it!?

I have detected the
presence of a large
ferocious creature in the
far depths of the cave. I
am ninety-nine percent
certain it is hostile.

Exactly, Captain! If we
want to save this planet,
we cannot shrink in the
face of danger!
Before you go in, I ask\nthat you make me one\nsimple promise.
Captain, Eve―whatever\nyou do make sure you\ncome back alive and safe.

To think you were so
touched by my heartfelt
words that it has
rendered you speechless...
You make it sound like\nwe're going to die...
Huh...?
No! That was not my\nintention at all!

It was more like a
blessing. If there is
anything we should learn
from literature, it is that
promises are
important―especially when
there is any uncertainty
regarding an outcome.

It is through my
foreshadowing of tragedy
that our Captain will be
saved!

In short, I am setting the
stage for a miracle!
Regardless of what
happens, our Captain shall
live on!
Aha! My apologies!
Truly, I am praying for\nyour success. Please\nmake no mistake about it.
We know that much!
...Thank you, Coro. Your\nthoughts are with us.

Now come, Captain! Let us
take down this thing and
return to the ship with
good news.
You have secured the\narea! Excellent work!
Now the only problem left\nto deal with is...
Aaah!
Ahhh!!!

We must find a way to
restore balance to this
planet that has been
plunged into chaos!
E.V.E.! Eve!
Are you feeling all right?\nYour vitals appear stable\nbut...
I am perfectly fine. Thank\nyou for the concern.
Now more importantly,\nwhat about the\nearthquakes?
They have completely\nstopped. It is very hard to\nbelieve.
Truly!? So it worked? I\ncannot tell you how happy\nI am to hear that!
It is, however, still too\nearly to celebrate. This is\nfar from the end.

Exactly. Before we move
forward, I have many
questions I need you to
answer.

You claim to have lost
your memory. Considering
the complexity of the
symbology you used,
however, I find that
difficult to believe.
Eve, you are hiding\nsomething from us.
If we do not broach this\nsubject now, we will\nforever remain in the dark!
It is true that Eve has\ndone nothing to put us in\ndanger up until now.
That, however, is not to\nsay she will not pose a\nthreat to us in the future!

I must apologize. It seems
my silence has caused
everyone a great deal of
distress.
Truth be told, I have not\nlost my memory.
I am truly sorry for having\nlied to you.

I have yet to fully
comprehend my situation
so I did not―and still do
not―know how to explain
what has happened to me.
Don't worry about it. Just\nremember, you can talk to\nus at any time.
So long as you are not\nhostile toward us, there is\nno problem.
We need to you around.\nYou're useful.
Thank you, <player>.
I promise that once I\nunderstand everything, I\nwill tell you.
I would never do anything\nto endanger or harm\neither of you. Ever.

Huh!? Am I simply a
tool―an ally you keep
around to help you with
summoning!?
...So that was just a joke?
I honestly thought you had\nbetter taste than that.
Captain, are you sure?
Are you absolutely sure?

You make me feel like I am
taking this issue far too
seriously. This is
embarrassing.
You're just worrying on\nthe Captain's behalf. It is\nnothing to be ashamed of.
I am a high-functioning AI\nthat has advanced danger\nanalysis features.

Eve, when you finally are
ready to talk about it, I
ask that you divulge
everything to us.
Having gaps in my data\ndoes not sit well with me!
Understood. Thank you,\nCoro.
This is terrible! A\ncatastrophe! A disaster!
I-I apologize. This,\nhowever, is a very serious\nsituation!
I have detected a\npowerful creature heading\nthis way at top speed!
In fact, it is now within\nviewing distance. It is a...
Thornite!
A thornite has pursued us\nall this way!?
Yes, and if it is chasing us\nthat means...
...Thornites are in some\nway connected to the\nPurge.

Now is not the time to be
calmly analyzing the
situation and coming up
with theories.
Yes! It is as you say. It is\nmaking a beeline for us!
Can we escape into orbit?
That thing will definitely\nreach us before we get\noff the ground!

Y-you are thinking to
ambush it!? ...Well, I do
suppose that is the only
choice we currently have.
Come on, Captain! Let's\nmove out!
I am glad to see the two\nof you are back in one\npiece.
That thornite... It was\nafter us...or more\nspecifically, me.

What does the Purge want
with me? Or was that
thornite simply acting of
its own accord?
I honestly cannot think of\na single reason as to why\nthey would target me.

Exactly! It is just as the
Captain says! The reason
does not matter. We
simply must rise to the
challenge and dispatch
them whenever they
should appear!
You are safe with us, Eve.\nWe protect our own!
Your enemies are our\nenemies and, together, we\nshall defeat them!
Thank you. You don't know\nwhat that means to me.\nLet's start ove―
Never mind.
What I wanted to say is I\nhope we continue to grow\ncloser.
Now then, I have attained\nthe coordinates for the\nnext star system.
...On to bigger and better\nadventures we go!

You have discovered a
New Route. You can now
choose this New Route
from the Select Planet
screen.
